description: The two pie charts represent the distribution of categories for "All Changes" and "All Errors". Each chart is divided into 6 slices, representing different categories labeled as PW (light green), R (yellow), RW (brown), N (light blue), and NW (blue), with an additional gray category that is not explicitly labeled in the charts but is included in the legend. The "All Changes" chart shows PW at 50%, R at 26%, RW at 14%, N at 1%, NW at 5%, and the gray category at 4%. The "All Errors" chart displays PW at 56%, R at 29%, RW at 6%, N at 1%, NW at 5%, and the gray category at 3%. Both charts include percentage labels outside the slices, and a legend is provided on the right side of the image, explaining the color coding for each category. The slices in both charts are visually ordered from largest to smallest.
